output.title: Which plans include a nurse callback?
output.draft_text:
Question: Which plans include a nurse callback?

Answer: A nurse callback is a service where a [nurse type, e.g., registered nurse] calls the member back to discuss their symptoms or health questions. Nurse callback is included with the following plans: [list of plans that include nurse callback]. It is not included with: [list of plans that do not include nurse callback, if any].

How members request a callback: Members can request a nurse callback by [request method, e.g., phone number, member portal, app]. Callbacks are available [hours and days of availability].

What to expect: A nurse will typically call back within [callback timeframe]. There is [cost or copay information, e.g., no cost] for this service.

Eligibility notes: [any eligibility requirements or restrictions, e.g., group plans only, state limitations, effective dates].

If a member's plan does not include nurse callback, advocates can direct them to [alternative resource]. If the member has a medical emergency, advise them to call [emergency number] or go to the nearest emergency room.

Confirm hours and days the service is available, including time zones and holidays.

Confirm whether there is any cost, copay, or limit on use.
